conventions.bytes_and_flops: FULL op (unsharded); topology model divides by its shard_axis
conventions.flops: multiply-add = 2 FLOPs; elementwise ops counted approximately
conventions.formulas: python expressions over symbols + constants; PREFILL bool, CKPT (0/1 prefix-cache checkpoint export), SCRATCH (0/1 materialized indexer logits), E_ACT (experts touched) are switches
conventions.layer_index: 0-based: config lists are 1-based (is_kda_layer(l) = l+1 in kda_layers, kimi_linear.py:225-235). KDA idx {0,1,2,4,5,6,...,90}; DSA idx {3,7,...,91,92}; layer 0 = KDA + dense MLP; layers 1..92 MoE

symbols.T: token rows of the forward (prefill: chunk tokens; decode/verify: B*q)
symbols.q: verify rows per request in decode = 1 + k
symbols.L: context length (KV tokens incl. this step's) of a request
symbols.Lsum: sum over query rows of visible keys (prefill chunk of C tokens after prefix P: C*P + C*(C+1)/2; decode: B*q*L)
symbols.Ltk: sum over query rows of min(visible keys, TOPK) (keys a sparse-MLA row reads)
symbols.Lu: sum over requests of unique context keys touched this step (HBM SOL: each request's cache read once; prefill: P+C, decode: L)
symbols.R: rows through lm_head (prefill: B last-token rows; decode: B*q)
symbols.AL: accepted tokens per request per step (incl. bonus)
symbols.Tc: DSpark context rows (prefill: T, SOL min(T, D_W) per request; decode stock: B*q, SOL: B*AL)
symbols.Tq: DSpark query rows = B*k (sample_from_anchor: k rows per request)
symbols.nseq: sequences in a prefill chunk (state read/write count)

ops.name: token embedding lookup
ops.shard_axis: vocab (VocabParallelEmbedding) -> partial rows need AR / SP reduce-scatter
ops.comm: TP: all-reduce [T,H] bf16 (or SP: reduce-scatter, sp_embed)
ops.notes: weight_bytes = rows touched only (2.35 GB table never streamed).

ops.name: AttnRes block buffer alloc/seed
ops.shapes: block_residual [T, NB, H] bf16; prefix_sum = embed
ops.notes: new_empty only (no traffic); blocks written by block-write layers.

ops.name: AttnRes pre-attention mix + input RMSNorm (attn_res kernel)
ops.shard_axis: token-parallel (replicated weights); runs on the rank's token shard under SP
ops.notes: Per token: rmsnorm of each source (dot with norm_w*qk_w) -> softmax over sources -> weighted sum -> output RMSNorm(input_layernorm). Sum over 93 layers of sources = 493 (avg 5.30); +1 read for delta, block-write layers (l%12==0, 8 of them) store prefix into blocks. Memory-bound in every regime (AI ~4 FLOP/B).

ops.name: AttnRes post-attention mix + post_attention RMSNorm
ops.notes: sum of sources over layers = 501; delta add writes prefix back (BF16).

ops.name: SP all-gather of attention input (topology-dependent)
ops.comm: SP/TP: all-gather T*H*2 bytes per layer (only when attention is head-sharded and the stream is token-sharded)
ops.notes: Present only in SP topologies (C512 hybrid). Listed so the topology model can switch it on.

ops.name: in_proj_qkvgfab (q|k|v|g full-rank, f_a low-rank gate, beta)
ops.shapes: [T, H] x [H, 4*P + dk + Hk] -> [T, 4*P + dk + Hk]
ops.shard_axis: N: q/k/v/g/beta head-sharded over TP; f_a (128) replicated
ops.notes: N = 4*12288 + 128 + 96 = 49376 (+pad to 16). 353.9M params, 708 MB BF16 per layer (the largest attention weight; 48.8 GB over 69 layers).

ops.name: f_b_proj (gate up-projection 128 -> 12288)
short causal depthwise conv (q,k,v; width 4) + SiLU
ops.shapes: [T, 3P] with FP32 weight [3P, 4], conv state [3P, CONV-1+k] fp32 per request
ops.state_write_bytes: (nseq if PREFILL else B)*3*P*(CONV-1+(0 if PREFILL else k))*4
ops.notes: Fused into the in_proj epilogue / decode kernel in the specialized decode (cutedsl/kda/inproj64.py). Conv state dtype = mamba_cache_dtype (FP32 per mission). Decode cache holds CONV-1+k columns (num_spec). SOL: fused into the neighbouring GEMM/kernel prologue/epilogue -> its activation bytes are not HBM traffic (kv/state bytes still count).

ops.name: KDA gate g=lb*sigmoid(A*(g1+dt_bias)), beta=sigmoid, q/k L2 norm
ops.notes: Always fused into the KDA core kernel (no separate traffic). gate_lower_bound=-5. SOL: fused into the neighbouring GEMM/kernel prologue/epilogue -> its activation bytes are not HBM traffic (kv/state bytes still count).

ops.name: chunked KDA (FlashKDA K1+K2, segscan) with FP32 state

dtype.compute: bf16_mma (state staged bf16 into k.S / q.S MMAs, fp32 accum/state)

ops.shard_axis: heads over TP (96 heads); segscan splits long sequences into segments
ops.notes: FLOPs per token per head with chunk C: 2C(3dk+2dv) [KK^T, QK^T, W=A(Kg b), U=A(Vb), intra O] + 6 dk dv [W.S, q.S, K^T.Vnew] + (2/3)C^2 [triangular inverse]; C=16 (FlashKDA) -> 119K, C=64 -> 183K FLOP/token/head. Segment-parallel scan (segscan) adds ~2x K2 state flops on segmented sequences (M_p, C_p) -- derate term, not SOL. CKPT=1 when a prefix-cache checkpoint state is exported for the chunk (mamba align mode), else 0. Serial K2 over chunks: parallelism limited to Hk/tp x nseq CTAs pairs (latency term).

ops.name: KDA verify recurrence (q rows/request) + deferred RecoverSSM commit
ops.shapes: q,k,v,g [B*q,Hk,dk]; state [B,Hk,dk,dv] fp32; records u,kg [B,q,Hk,dk] bf16
ops.notes: Per verify row per head: decay (dk dv), S^T k (2 dk dv), rank-1 update (2 dk dv), q.S (2 dk dv) = 7 dk dv; deferred commit folds the previous step's AL accepted tokens (decay + outer product ~3 dk dv each) in the same pass. SOL traffic: FP32 state read once + written once per request per layer = 2*96*128*128*4 = 12.6 MB (869 MB per request per step over 69 layers) -- THE dominant decode byte term. Records (REC_B = 1024 B per row per head: FP32 correction [dk] + key_gate [2*dk] in the state dtype, recoverssm/context.py allocate_records) are written for all q rows and read back for the AL accepted rows next step; kv.py capacity uses the same REC_B. Non-deferred alternatives: stock RecoverSSM commit after sampling (read S twice, write once) or q-slot state writes (write q states).

ops.name: gated RMSNorm (o_norm, sigmoid(g2) gate, per-head 128)
ops.notes: Fused into the decode kernel (output_gate / norm_weight args); separate in prefill. SOL: fused into the neighbouring GEMM/kernel prologue/epilogue -> its activation bytes are not HBM traffic (kv/state bytes still count).

ops.name: o_proj 12288 -> 7168 (+ fused o_norm gate read)
ops.notes: act_in includes the fused o_norm gate read (T*P*2).
ops.comm: TP: all-reduce (or RS under SP) of [T,H] bf16 partial sums; fused GEMM-AR (gemm_rs_ar) available

ops.name: packed [q_a | kv_a(+k_pe) | indexer wk | indexer weights_proj]
ops.shapes: [T, H] x [H, QLR + KVL + DR + Di + Ni] -> [T, QLR + KVL + DR + Di + Ni]
ops.shard_axis: replicated (disable_tp) in TP; under DSA-DP owned by one card
ops.notes: N = 1536+512+64+128+32 = 2272. k_pe exists although the model is NoPE (mla_use_nope): the 64 dims are stored, not rotated.

ops.name: fused prologue: q_a RMSNorm, kv_a RMSNorm, FP8 MLA KV insert, indexer key LayerNorm + MXFP4 quant + insert
ops.shard_axis: token rows (replicated in TP: every rank writes its own copy unless DCP/DSA-DP stores KV once)
ops.notes: fp8_ds_mla row = 656 B (512 FP8 latent + 4 fp32 scales + 64 bf16 rope); MXFP4 indexer key = 68 B. kv_c_normed (bf16) also kept for the prefill path.

ops.name: packed [q_b (96 x 192) | indexer wq (32 x 128)]
ops.shapes: [T, QLR] x [QLR, Nh*DQK + Ni*Di] -> [T, Nh*DQK + Ni*Di]
ops.shard_axis: N: q_b head-sharded over TP; wq_index replicated (indexer scored per rank)

ops.name: output-gate projection 7168 -> 96*128
ops.notes: Runs on an aux stream overlapping the attention front-end for small batches.

ops.name: indexer query MXFP4 quant + head-weight fold
ops.notes: SOL: fused into the neighbouring GEMM/kernel prologue/epilogue -> its activation bytes are not HBM traffic (kv/state bytes still count).

ops.name: indexer scoring logits[t,s]=sum_h w[t,h]*relu(q[t,h].k[s]) over the full context
ops.shapes: q [T,32,128] mxfp4, keys [L,128] mxfp4 (68 B) -> logits [T, L]
ops.shard_axis: TP: every rank scores the whole context (replicated) unless DCP splits keys / DSA-DP gives the request to one card / ShardQ splits query rows
ops.notes: Prefill: causal, Lsum = C*P + C(C+1)/2 per request. Skipped for rows with L <= TOPK (short-context bypass). Decode: one [128 keys x q*32] MMA per tile reads every key once per request per step (kv_read = L*68 B), FLOPs 2*32*128*q*L. SCRATCH=1 when logits are materialized (stock + current specialized: BF16 [T,L] write + read by select); SCRATCH=0 for a fused score+select (new method). At L=135K: 26.5 GFLOP per query row over 24 layers. Split (review 2026-11-17): flops = the FP4 MMA only; simt_flops = the per-(row,key) FP32 epilogue relu + head-weight FMA over the 32 heads (2 instructions = 4 FMA-FLOP equivalents per head) at the FP32 SIMT rate; t = max(mma, epilogue, bytes). A packed BF16x2 epilogue would halve it but rounds the logits (not stock precision). Microbench: DeepGEMM fp4_mqa_logits times both parts together.

ops.name: exact top-2048 over L logits per row (radix select)
ops.shard_axis: rows; under DCP each rank selects a local top-k then a merge exchange
ops.comm: DCP: local top-k candidates exchanged (decode packed top-N merge, prefill histogram merge) -- size T*TOPK*(4..8) B per rank
ops.notes: Exact (mission). Also converts logical -> physical KV slots.

ops.name: W_UK absorption: q_nope [T,96,128] x W_UK^T [96,128,512] -> q_lat
ops.notes: kv_b_proj [512 -> 96*(128+128)] (12.6M params) is split into W_UK / W_UV; with contexts > TOPK both prefill and decode run the absorbed MQA path (dense MHA prefill only when prefill_max_seq_len <= 2048, sparse_mla_attention.py:172). Query row = 512 latent + 64 rope = 576.

ops.name: sparse MLA (FlashMLA sparse, absorbed MQA) over top-2048
ops.shapes: q [T,96,576] bf16; KV gathered [T,2048,576] fp8_ds_mla -> o_lat [T,96,512]

dtype.compute: fp8_mma (FP8 Q x FP8 KV for QK^T, FP8 P x FP8 V; per-tensor FP8 576-B row)

ops.shard_axis: heads (TP: 96/tp heads, decode pads to 64/rank); DCP: keys; DSA-DP: request owner
ops.notes: Compute dtype follows the KV row (model.op_dtype): the 576-B per-tensor FP8 row (SM10x default) runs FP8 Q x FP8 KV MMAs (flashinfer_mla_sparse.py:1092-1095 requires FP8 q with an FP8 cache; sdec attn_fi.py runs FP8 query rows [B,H,576]); the 656-B fp8_ds_mla row dequantizes to BF16. sfu_ops = one exp per (row, head, key) at the MUFU rate (co-bound with FP8 MMA: 2176 MMA FLOPs per exp); simt_flops = online-softmax scale/max/sum. kv_read uses one SOL rule in both phases: the union of a request's rows, bounded by min(Lu, Ltk) (prefill: request cache once; decode: q*2048 when L >= q*2048 -- the q verify rows' top-k sets overlap heavily, so the true union is smaller; reading 2048 rows per request instead is worth ~2% of a high-r DEP step). l2_gather_bytes = gathered volume (every row reads its 2048 rows: 1.34 MB/row/layer). kv_read_bytes = HBM SOL: prefill unique rows min(Lu, Ltk)*656 (each request's cache once); decode Ltk*656 (no cross-row dedupe; dedupe lower bound B*2048*656) -- in prefill the request's whole cache (L*656 = 88.6 MB/layer at 135K) fits L2 (132 MB) so gather hits L2; in decode q verify rows of a request overlap heavily (union <= q*2048). Intensity on gathered bytes = 2*96*1088/656 = 318 FLOP/B (BF16 ridge 259) -> compute-bound-ish if L2-fed; decode is gather/latency bound. Rows with L<=2048 attend all L keys (Ltk counts min(L, TOPK)).

ops.name: output gate sigmoid(g) * attn_out
ops.notes: Fusable into o_proj prologue (mxfp8 variant: gate_sigmoid_mul_quantize). SOL: fused into the neighbouring GEMM/kernel prologue/epilogue -> its activation bytes are not HBM traffic (kv/state bytes still count).

ops.name: o_proj 12288 -> 7168
ops.notes: act_in includes the fused gate_mul gate read (T*Nh*DV*2).
ops.comm: TP: all-reduce / reduce-scatter [T,H] bf16 partial sums; DSA-DP: push_out of o (or o_lat) rows back to the TP group before o_proj

ops.name: router gate 7168 -> 896 (fp32 logits)
ops.notes: bf16 x bf16 -> fp32 cuBLAS; overlaps routed down-proj on an aux stream (<=256 tokens).

ops.name: sigmoid + e_score_correction_bias, top-16 of 896, renormalize
ops.notes: noaux_tc, one expert group; routed_scaling_factor 1.0. SOL: fused into the neighbouring GEMM/kernel prologue/epilogue -> its activation bytes are not HBM traffic (kv/state bytes still count).

ops.name: routed_expert_down_proj 7168 -> 3584 (latent)
MegaMoE dispatch of latent rows to expert owners
ops.shapes: [T,3584] -> T*16 (token,expert) rows; dedup per destination rank possible
ops.comm: EP: T*min(TOPK_E, EP)*LAT*MXFP8_B bytes leave the rank in the worst case (per (token, destination rank) dedup; fraction (EP-1)/EP remote). In-kernel (fused dispatch, symmetric memory).
ops.notes: Activation dtype: MXFP8 up to 512 tokens/rank (RUBIN_MX_MAX_TOKENS_PER_RANK, experts.py:87), NVFP4 (w4a4, exact MXFP4->NVFP4 weight conversion) above -- mission allows MXFP8 activations; NVFP4 activation is an open rule question.

ops.name: expert FC1 (w13 gate|up) 3584 -> 6144, MXFP4 weights x MXFP8 act
ops.notes: E_ACT = experts touched this step = E*(1-(1-16/896)^T) (all 896 once T >~ 300); weights 11.7 MB/expert (FC1) -> 10.5 GB/layer. Rows per expert = 16T/896 = T/56: compute-bound only when T/56 >~ 200 (T >~ 11K tokens per EP group).

ops.name: SiTU(gate)*up (+clamp) and MXFP8 requant (fused in MegaMoE)
ops.notes: beta=4, linear_beta=25 (tanh-based SiTU). Fused (no HBM traffic). SOL: fused into the neighbouring GEMM/kernel prologue/epilogue -> its activation bytes are not HBM traffic (kv/state bytes still count).

ops.name: expert FC2 (w2) 3072 -> 3584, MXFP4 weights x MXFP8 act
MegaMoE combine (weighted sum of 16 expert rows, BF16)
ops.comm: EP: return T*16*LAT*2 B (per (token,expert)) or T*min(16,EP)*LAT*2 B if each rank pre-reduces its experts' rows per token
ops.notes: BF16 combine per mission.

ops.name: routed latent RMSNorm (3584)
ops.notes: Fusable into the up-proj prologue. SOL: fused into the neighbouring GEMM/kernel prologue/epilogue -> its activation bytes are not HBM traffic (kv/state bytes still count).

ops.name: routed_expert_up_proj 3584 -> 7168 (+ shared output beta-add)
ops.shard_axis: replicated (token-parallel); shared partial added in epilogue

ops.notes: SOL: fused into the neighbouring GEMM/kernel prologue/epilogue -> its activation bytes are not HBM traffic (kv/state bytes still count).

final RMSNorm (applied in compute_logits on logit rows)
ops.notes: SOL: fused into the neighbouring GEMM/kernel prologue/epilogue -> its activation bytes are not HBM traffic (kv/state bytes still count).

ops.name: lm_head 7168 -> 163840 (target verify / last-token logits)
ops.shard_axis: N = vocab over TP (each rank its vocab shard)
ops.notes: 2.35 GB BF16 weights; decode R = B*q rows.
ops.comm: TP: argmax/top token exchange or sampled-verify partial reductions (no full-vocab gather on the fast path: verify/exchange.py)

ops.name: probabilistic rejection sampling (target vs draft probs) + bonus

dtype.act_in: fp32 target logits / head_dtype draft logits

ops.shard_axis: vocab over TP (sampled_verify.run on shard logits)
ops.comm: TP: per-row LSE / max / sampled-candidate exchange, O(B*q*tp*16 B)
ops.notes: softmax (LSE) of target and draft per row, accept test p/q, residual max(0,p-q) resample at first rejection, bonus sample. Memory-bound on the logit bytes. Prefill: plain sampling of R rows (R*V*4 read).

ops.name: aux hidden capture: AttnRes stream after target layers 75,79,83,87,91 (aux ids 76..92)
ops.shapes: [AUXR,H] per aux layer: prefix_sum + pending_mlp_out (prefix_only mode)
ops.notes: Release default VLLM_KIMI_K3_AUX_ATTN_RES_STREAM=0 = 'prefix_only' (model.py:1691-1700, vllm/envs.py:232; release sweep logs 'mode=prefix_only'): aux = prefix_sum + pending_mlp_out, one add. Prefill: only the Tc consumed rows (O7: last 2048 per request); decode: all T verify rows (acceptance unknown in the forward).

ops.name: context fc: cat(5 aux) 35840 -> 7168
ops.shard_axis: replicated; row-sharded over TP for >=256 rows/rank (combine_aux_rows)
ops.notes: 256.9M params (514 MB). Decode stock graph runs all B*q verify rows; SOL B*AL. Prefill (P/D prefill instance) runs it on the 16K chunk; SOL only the last D_W=2048 tokens per request matter for the sliding window (new method).

ops.name: hidden_norm RMSNorm of context rows

ops.notes: 20,480 B per context token (BF16, 5 layers). Prefill SOL: only the last 2048 tokens of the prompt need draft KV. SOL: fused into the neighbouring GEMM/kernel prologue/epilogue -> its activation bytes are not HBM traffic (kv/state bytes still count).
